# Talview

> Talview is a comprehensive talent assessment and recruitment platform combining AI-powered video interviews, psycholinguistic behavioral analysis, and automated skill testing for campus hiring and enterprise talent acquisition.

Talview provides end-to-end recruitment solutions leveraging advanced technologies including automated video interviews, cognitive analytics, virtual machine-based skill assessments, and AI-powered proctoring. The platform serves enterprise clients and educational institutions seeking to streamline hiring, reduce bias, and identify top talent efficiently.

## Key Topics

- Talent Assessment
- Psycholinguistics
- Behavioral Insights
- Video Interviews
- Campus Recruitment
- AI-Powered Proctoring

- Talent Engagement

## Core Products & Solutions

- [Campus Recruitment](https://info.talview.com/campus-recruitment): Talview's campus recruitment solution with video interviews and assessments.
- [Change the game of Campus Recruitment - Talview](https://info.talview.com/change-the-game-of-campus-recruitment): Campus recruitment platform featuring automated video and assessments.
- [Computer Based Applications Skill Assessing Tool - Talview](https://info.talview.com/virtual-machine-online-skill-test): Virtual machine-based skill assessment tool for technical evaluations.
- [What's New 2017 | Talview](https://info.talview.com/whats-new-2017): Product demo showcasing Talview's talent assessment and hiring capabilities.
